items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: Sam Dockery on piano and we had a surprise guest, Babs Gonzales come up, just to sing with us.

ctx.x: MR. WARE: September. Anyway, I went out there but I was feeling very ill. I could hardly carry my instrument and I was gasping for breath. We were to play with Kenny Clarke. Kenny Clarke. It was going to be one of his first gigs. He had come over to me that reunion, TV show that Public Broadcasting Station out there, which he did with Dizzy and Moody, Sarah, Milt, Al Haug, Ray Brown. So Al Haug and Klook stayed out there and Clifford and myself, we went out for Joe Sagal to form a quartet. We played at the Jazz…

I made it, though. I wasn't comfortable at all. I could hardly -- I played, but I was gasping for breath. I was like a fish out of water. I wasn't under the correct medication. So I got on the plane coming home. I just didn't make it home. I was home up until I had a job here in Philly called At the Foxhole and I was going to use Clifford --
